title: Premium Loads and Monthly Charges on Universal Life Insurance, by Tier
content:
Premium loads and the fixed parts of the monthly deduction on Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance are set per tier as follows. The premium load is taken from each premium received; the policy fee and the per-thousand expense charge are part of the monthly deduction taken on each monthly anniversary.

## Rate card

| Item | Lifetime Guarantee UL | Protection UL | Accumulation UL | Indexed UL Protect | Indexed UL Growth | Indexed UL Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Premium load on premium received in a policy year up to the target premium | 8% | 6% | 5% | 6% | 5% | 5% |
| Premium load on premium received in a policy year above the target premium | 4% | 3% | 2% | 3% | 2% | 2% |
| Smallest unscheduled premium accepted | $25 | $25 | $25 | $25 | $25 | $25 |
| Monthly policy fee | $10.00 | $10.00 | $10.00 | $10.00 | $10.00 | $15.00 |
| Monthly expense charge per $1000 of initial face | $0.0800 | $0.0800 | $0.0800 | $0.0800 | $0.0800 | $0.0600 |
| Policy years from issue during which the expense charge applies | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Latest day of the month for a planned-premium EFT draft | 28 | 28 | 28 | 28 | 28 | 28 |
| Premium that would make the policy a modified endowment contract accepted only with the owner's written consent | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

The two load percentages are written as decimals in the policy accounting system: 0.08, 0.06, 0.05 up to the target premium and 0.04, 0.03, 0.02 above it.

## Reading the card

- **Which load band.** Premium received in a policy year is loaded at the first rate until the premiums of that policy year reach the policy's target premium, and at the second rate on the part above it.
- **Expense charge period.** The per-thousand expense charge is charged in policy years 1 through 10 on every tier and not from policy year 11.
- **Initial face.** The per-thousand charge is figured on the face amount at issue, not on the current face.

## Hypothetical figures

An Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier policy issued with an initial face of $2000000 carries, in policy year 3, a monthly policy fee of $15.00 and an expense charge of 2000 thousands times $0.0600, which is $120.00, so $135.00 of fixed monthly charges before the cost of insurance. The same face on an Ashgrove Protection UL carries $10.00 and $160.00, which is $170.00. In policy year 11 only the policy fee remains on either policy.
